title: Static typed Wide selected-column metadata and exact physical stream identity

claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the finite declared Wide selected-column target
claim.global_goal: ACTIVE; all-types/MV/projection coverage and subsequent <=10% speed goal are not closed
claim.meaning: Curated index to observed root source, tests and raw captures. Field presence, hashes alone and correlated model agreement are not behavioral proof.

risk.boundary: Persistent serializer metadata and selected public/offline typed consumer admission
risk.rollback: One exact-path local atomic feature commit; no push, dependency change or history rewrite.

families: Already admitted typed Array, excluding generic Array(Tuple)
Named scalar Tuple within the existing type plan
laws: Exact selected declaration and unique physical names, not a two-column or unique UInt64 sibling law.
Exact four-key envelope: version 1, propagated versions true, exactly string version 1, explicit sparse columns array.
Omitted records mean implicit Default only inside the validated envelope; explicit records have mandatory valid part row/default counts, known names and optional boolean exact_num_defaults.
Bounded common fields and all known Tuple positional descendants are validated before unsupported kind/shape/version classification; existing type plan owns Tuple identity.
Corruption hard-fails. Well-formed unproven profiles permit at most one existing legacy metadata validation, not another codec.
Admitted selected substreams match an exact unique name set, then canonicalize for existing bindings; an unselected sibling is a UInt64 key only with the physical UInt64 declaration.
Existing codecs, typed carriers, checksum/mark/budget/prefix/materialization owners are reused. No per-product serializer or fixture-schema allowlist.

features: Mixed caller selection and exact owned offline values

local_refusals: Malformed JSON/common fields/counts/exact flags, duplicate/unmapped column names, malformed known Tuple descendants
Symlink, file-change and checksum/mark grid corruption
Unknown/unproven envelope versions, kinds and shapes without existing legacy admission
Missing/duplicate/extra selected substreams; unadmitted type arms
non_guarantees: Every unselected non-UInt64 sibling's declared-type substream roster
Arbitrary recursive products, new types, JSON/Dynamic/Nested layouts and top-level Compact read/write
General key/partition derivation, MV SQL/provenance/triggers/freshness, parent .proj reader authentication
Full-repository suite, exhaustive production corruption handling, cross-version/endianness portability
RSS/allocation/throughput improvement, concurrency/crash durability, global <=10% performance parity

review.reviewed: Full new owner and all production diffs; independent of Luna conclusions.
observations: Known Tuple identity comes from the existing bounded WideTupleTypePlan, not literal grammar.
Common top records and all schema-bound Tuple positions are checked before unproven envelope/kind/shape can trigger one legacy validation.
Malformed JSON/type/count/duplicate/unmapped/common flags remain hard CorruptPartError.
Exact selected stream identity is unique checked and canonicalized; generic Array(Tuple), Map, Geo, JSON and Dynamic do not gain roster relaxation.
Sibling UInt64 role requires physical declaration; public key policy/carriers/codecs/marks/checksums/budgets untouched.
review.residual: Selected-column admission is not full declared-type validation of every unselected non-UInt64 sibling stream roster.
review.verdict: ROBUST within the declared W258 selected-column target
review.basis: Independent complete production review, 180 examples per mode, raw reciprocal native and byte audits, actual 14 refusal controls plus separate mocked/None controls

retained_owners: Existing typed per-family codecs and public batches
Existing checksum, marks, prefix/version, materialization and shared budget owners
